recentItems.title: Young French Protesters Have a Message for Macron
recentItems.description:
“There are rats in our classroom. There is no teacher.” From deteriorating schools to the rising cost of living, we spoke with young protesters in Paris about their grievances, their demands, and their message to Emmanuel Macron.

But could their anti-establishment anger ultimately empower the very political forces they oppose?

Joost Bastmeijer reports. Read more at ViceNews.com.

recentItems.title: WHAT FRANCE'S PROTESTS MEAN FOR THE FUTURE
recentItems.description:
From Paris to Athens, anger over rising rents, stagnant wages and an uncertain future is driving young Europeans into the streets. But their protests could have political consequences far beyond what they intended.

Dave Keating went to Paris to find out what’s at stake for the future of Europe.

Read on: https://www.vicenews.com/p/europes-youth-are-revolting-but-what

recentItems.title: Somali Pirates Are Back. Are the Houthis Helping Them?
recentItems.description:
Somali piracy is back. After years of naval patrols pushing it down, pirates are hijacking ships off the Horn of Africa again. Now there are growing fears they could be working with the Houthis.

Follow our coverage at ViceNews.com.

recentItems.title: Shane Smith Speaks to Aaron Parnas from Moscow
recentItems.description:
During his visit to Moscow, Tucker Carlson claimed that Russian life had been largely unaffected by the war and Western sanctions.

Reporting from Russia, Shane Smith, Editor-in-Chief of VICE News, tells Aaron Parnas a more complicated story—long gas lines, a quieter capital, and rising costs, even as daily life continues and construction booms.

recentItems.title: LIVE FROM RUSSIA | VICE News
recentItems.description:
VICE News Editor-In-Chief, Shane Smith, reports on the ground in Moscow.

recentItems.title: Nick Offerman Says Consumerism Sold Us a Lie About Work
recentItems.description:
Nick Offerman has “always understood the gratification of having good work to do.” Now, he thinks we’re losing something important in the age of consumerism.

“People think that somehow work is beneath them. They think that things are disposable.”
